Rules & backup

Work RVU rules

2026 work RVUs for completed EGD and colonoscopy, before any employer-specific adjustments.

  • Count each separately reportable code at 100% of its work RVUs. EGD + colonoscopy are added in full. No 50% payment cuts or diagnostic-base subtraction.
  • For a single lesion, select only the final technique: snare includes its biopsy, and EMR includes its biopsy/snare. Do not select component techniques for that same lesion.
  • Selecting multiple techniques means they were performed on separate lesions/sites and are independently reportable. They count automatically, with no extra confirmation. Modifier 59/XS may be required for distinct services; it does not change the published work-RVU value.
  • One code per technique per scope, even for multiple biopsies or polyps. Diagnostic work is already included in a therapeutic code. “Cases” means identical patient encounters, not lesions.
  • Select upper and lower techniques independently. Biopsies in both scopes count once in each scope.
  • Averages = total work RVUs ÷ dates with saved entries. Empty dates are excluded.

Cold forceps only; hot forceps use different codes. These are full work-RVU values, not a claim or payment estimate. Incomplete procedures, screening HCPCS codes, sedation and other interventions are outside this quick-entry model.

Older entries are recalculated with full work RVUs. Multiple techniques in existing entries are also treated as separate lesions/sites, as requested. Your entries, dates and case counts are preserved; a pre-update backup is kept on this device.

Schedules & analysis

Enter patients scheduled and how many are doubles for each day. Scheduled procedures = patients + doubles. A completed Colon / EGD case counts as two procedures, one colonoscopy, one EGD and one double. Biopsy, snare and EMR selections do not add to procedure counts.

Running averages stop at today. Completed procedure averages use dates with a saved case or schedule, including scheduled dates with no completed cases. Scheduled averages exclude dates without a saved schedule; saved zero counts are included. Work RVU averages still use only days with completed cases.

Keep a copy

JSON backups include completed cases and daily schedules. Import keeps newer edits and honors saved deletions. Older backups remain supported without erasing newer schedules.

Install & updates

iPhone: open in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Once loaded, the app works offline. New versions are checked on opening and applied automatically when no entry is being edited.

Entries remain in this browser/device. Back up before clearing website data or changing phones. No patient names or identifiers are collected.

Import backup

Existing entries will be merged, not replaced. Matching IDs are kept only once; newer edits and deletions win.
